digest.component_or_area: DC outbound reconciliation / comment and description sync
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions, while Cloud has them to prevent re-emission of truncated values across multiple passes

DC's sanitize_comment binds to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) using the description fitter fit_outbound, but the ceiling's provenance is undocumented and the binding appears to conflate comment and description limits
The DC ceiling is correctly set to 32767 per jira.text.field.character.limit default in jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519, covering both comments and text custom fields by design, not as a shortcut

Two-pass convergence tests must inject DC backend explicitly (outbound_mapper, inbound_mapper, links for description; sanitizer for comments) rather than relying on config fallback, which silently resolves to Cloud

Comment convergence test requires identity/recording proof that the injected DC sanitizer executed, not value-based assertion, because DC and Cloud truncate at the same 32767 limit with identical suffix
Description ceiling and provenance must be documented at the WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT binding to replace assumption with citation of jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519
